alignments.note: Imperative with its subject pronoun; the *ye* stands immediately after the verb, so it is the verb's under rule 17 and rule 36's word-order test, not the vocative's.
The ASV writes the full divine name for the short form; the marginal gloss 'Hebrew Hallelujah' is read and set aside under rule 38.
Second imperative, rendered bare; no *ye* is written for it.
Object marker with no English of its own: the ASV writes the object bare (rule 16).
Direct object of the second imperative.
Vocative noun with its supplied *O* under rule 36, discontinuous around the possessive under rule 25.

review_notes: The verse's two *Praise* imperatives are separate morphemes and each takes the word written for it; only the first carries a subject pronoun.
The marginal note 'Hebrew Hallelujah' was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
